# Synthetic fixture data

These JSON files are generated by scripts/generate-fixtures.js. They represent invented geometry, not real streets or current road conditions. Synthetic JSON data is dedicated under CC0-1.0: https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/ . This designation applies to the generated fixture JSON only; no application-code license is selected here.

synthetic-source.json is the exact source-byte artifact; each manifest hash refers to these bytes. Variant transformations are recorded separately. Fixed dates are recipe metadata for reproducible synthetic content, not claims that an external dataset was fetched at that time.

street-square.json is a complete supported pack. packs.json contains supported and intentionally invalid variants. expected.json distinguishes current import-validation expectations from future scorer/storage cases. Scoring and persistence are not implemented by this fixture generator.

Regenerate with npm run fixtures; verify exact reproduction with npm run fixtures:check. Do not hand-edit generated JSON without updating the recipe. Real OSM packs and large raw extracts will remain outside git unless specifically reviewed for redistribution.

The elevation fixtures are also invented CC0 data. `terrain-recipe.json` specifies analytic flat, hill, valley and rectangular-plane formulas; `terrain-grids.json` contains seven cases including missing samples, international feet and legacy US survey feet. Every grid hashes the exact recipe JSON bytes. The fixed `acquiredAt` is synthetic recipe metadata, not an external fetch timestamp. Regeneration and byte-for-byte checking use the same commands above. No real DEM is committed.
